notes: ORDERS is the DETAIL pipeline, CUSTOMERS the MASTER pipeline; master ports are marked PORTTYPE="INPUT/OUTPUT/MASTER" (real PowerCenter spelling). SQ_CUSTOMERS.CUST_ID is connected to the Joiner master port CUST_ID1.

Join Condition (master = detail, as the Designer writes it): CUST_ID1 = CUST_ID AND REGION = ORDER_REGION -- both keys must match. Join Type uses the real attribute values 'Normal Join', 'Master Outer Join', 'Detail Outer Join', 'Full Outer Join'.
Normal Join keeps only matched pairs (4 rows). Duplicate detail keys (orders 101 and 102 for customer 1/EAST) each pair with the master row.
Master Outer Join keeps ALL DETAIL rows plus matching master rows; unmatched detail rows carry NULL master ports (8 rows).
Detail Outer Join keeps ALL MASTER rows plus matching detail rows; unmatched master rows carry NULL detail ports (7 rows).
Full Outer Join keeps all rows from both sides (11 rows).
The multi-key condition discriminates: order 104 (cust 2, EAST) matches master 'Bolt East' (2, EAST), not 'Bolt' (2, WEST); order 105 (cust 1, WEST) matches nothing.

A NULL join key never matches, not even another NULL: order 106 (NULL cust) does not pair with master 'Ghost' (NULL cust, EAST); order 107 (cust 5, NULL region) does not pair with master 'NoRegion' (5, NULL region).
Target columns M_CUST_ID and M_REGION are fed from the master ports CUST_ID1 and REGION (connector renames).
